List of sync pairs

  • Italiano
  • 日本語

This is a list of sync pairs in Pokémon Masters EX, listed in the order they are presented in the Sync Pair Stories menu.

Move types are also listed according to the Dex page. Only damaging move types are listed.

Starting in version 1.11.0, the player can form sync pairs with Pokémon that are hatched by random chance from Pokémon Eggs. The list of these pairs can be found here.
